pages.title: Blowout!
pages.text: Plays when worn-out skates give way mid-race: a blowout, and the race is over. Skitchin' (EA, 1994), Mega Drive / Genesis. Music by Jeff van Dyck.

pages.title: Your gear
pages.text: Six things wear out: skates, wheels, knee pads, elbow pads, wrist guards and gloves. Each comes in five grades: Economy, Beginner, Standard, Quality and Professional.

pages.title: Face Plant
pages.text: EA also planned a snow version, Face Plant: Road Rash on skis and snowboards, with 15 rivals and a no-rules Free Ride. Sega Zone put it on a cover in December 1993; it was quietly cancelled.
